tasks.label: Run PWA Server (8091)
tasks.command: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -m http.server 8091 --bind 127.0.0.1 } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python -m http.server 8091 --bind 127.0.0.1 } else { Write-Error 'Python was not found. Install Python or use Live Server.'; exit 1 }
